newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes up as IPB bank surges.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes up as IPB bank surges.

text.p: The Czech PX50 posted solid gains on Friday led by IPB bank which was boosted by an announcment on Thursday that the government will sell its 36 percent stake in the bank to Japan's Nomura International plc.
IPB jumped 19 crowns or 7.8 percent to 262 following on a three percent gain in the previous session.

Despite the strong uptrend, analysts said further growth may be limited pending an audit on IPB which will determine whether the six billion crown buying price announced by the Finance Ministry will in fact hold. The strength of Nomura's long term committment to IPB was also questionned by some.

"I do not see much more potential at this point for the share price. My concern is the final price Nomura is going to pay. I think that the market will look at the final price very closely," said Richard Podpiera of Atlantik Financial Markets.
"Now the bank was not very transparent and Nomura will know (after the audit) how much the bank is actually worth," he added.
Podpiera said he did not expect IPB's share price to rise by more than one or two percentage points in the near term.
